summary.intent: Use the GSD manager workflow to discuss, plan, and execute three UAT audit gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone, parallelizing work across phases from a single terminal.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 (API unpin integrity) fully closed out with 8 plans executed across 3 waves plus code review and verification. Phase 43 (FUSE write durability) was substantially completed through 8 gap-closure plans across 6 waves with re-verification underway; a final Windows CR-08 alignment fix was committed but phase close-out was not yet finalized. Phase 44 context and discussion logs were written but planning and execution had not started.

repo: Kubo runs with the 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 publicly exposed (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72) — it keeps full public DHT participation, broadcasting provider records for every pinned CID; the server profile only disables local-network discovery.

The POST /ipfs/unpin endpoint is guarded only by JwtAuthGuard with open signup (Web3Auth), and the controller never reads req.user — any JWT holder could unpin any CID they harvested, enabling cross-tenant data destruction.
CIDs are discoverable without compromise: DHT provider records, IPNS resolution, and share recipients all expose pinned CIDs publicly.
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids silently without calling unpin (shared-write.ts:450) — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists in the codebase.
The upload-compensation path in ipfs.controller.ts:122 fires a global pin/rm, meaning a deduped CID shared between users could be unpinned by one user's delete.
BYO IPFS 'not pinned' errors were being swallowed server-side — the new guardedUnpin fixes this for free by treating missing advisory rows as no-ops.

pnpm filter + jest testPathPattern interaction: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` silently breaks (pnpm inserts its own '--', making jest treat the pattern as a positional regex); must use `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`.
gsd commit helper returns `committed: false` as a false negative — always verify with git log, never blind-retry based on the helper's return value.
1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git Bash tool calls; signing failures require the user to restart the 1Password desktop app.
No .prettierignore existed before this session — prettier was mangling .planning/ markdown and GSD-controlled JS files on every lint-staged pre-commit run.

cargo build -p cipherbox-fuse --features winfsp cannot succeed on macOS due to pre-existing cross-compilation failures in windows-future and winfsp-sys; cargo check on cipherbox project crates still works.

Phase 43 WriteQueue: the per-CID advisory lock (pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid))) closes the concurrent-unpin refcount race — without it a concurrent double-unpin could leave a zero-row stranded pin with an empty outbox.

Replay correctness requires journaling the parent IPNS key hex (parent_ipns_key_hex via wrap_key) before the upload spawn, not just the child key — otherwise replay cannot re-sign and publish the parent directory pointer.

code.finding: Upload-compensation path fires a global pin/rm on CIDs that may be content-addressed-shared with other users — now rerouted through guardedUnpin.
handle_mkdir: journal.put must occur inside the closure before reply.entry (line 655) to satisfy D-04 journal-before-ack ordering.
handle_release ordering: journal.put(844) → handle.cleanup(892) → reply.ok(894) → spawn(904) → journal.remove-on-success(943) — exact sequence required by D-04/D-05.

CR-04: missing reply.error(EIO) on journal fsync failure meant the OS received reply.ok after a failed write; CR-08: spawn_journal.remove was called after upload success creating an orphan window — removal must be gated on parent-pointer publish success instead.

UploadSpawnParams types were wrong (ApiClient, Handle, PublishCoordinator); journal entry was not carried into spawn for record_failure; removal was not gated on per-file IPNS publish — all three mirrored the macOS CR-05/07/08 fixes.

New guardedUnpin method: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) scopes the advisory lock to the transaction, atomically delete row → refcount → if last reference insert pending_unpins → commit → post-commit Kubo pin/rm best-effort.
Kubo v0.40 runs with server profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp) — full DHT participation, not isolated; all pinned CIDs are announced as provider records.
WriteParked bridge uses a two-arm match (D-10) to distinguish new WriteParked events from other sync status transitions before forwarding to tray notification.

workflow: GSD cleanup-wave must be run from the repository root — running it with cwd inside an agent worktree causes false base_mismatch errors because the helper resolves repoRoot from cwd.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun. Solution: write a reduced manifest containing only the remaining unmerged entries before each retry.
Worktree cruft (node_modules, .husky/_) must be removed before running cleanup-wave — untracked directories cause the merge to abort for the entire manifest run.
A MERGE_HEAD left after an auto-resolved conflict requires explicit `git commit --no-edit` to finalize — the cleanup-wave script does not handle this automatically.
openapi.json gets formatting-only drift from `nest build` side-effects; restore with `git checkout --` before merging worktrees to avoid spurious merge conflicts.
Session quota interruptions require re-dispatching background executors with fresh agent IDs; the previous worktree branches remain intact and can be inspected before re-dispatch.
Phase branches should be rebased onto the completed predecessor branch before planning begins so plans and commits have clean ancestry.
TDD gate commits must use separate RED (failing tests only) and GREEN (implementation) commits with matching prefixes — plan-checker validates these syntactically.
For the decision coverage gate, plan must_haves sections need literal citation strings (e.g., 'D-07:') for the mechanical grep to pass — a prose description without the tag fails the gate.
gsd-tools `query phase.complete` auto-closes todos only when they carry a `resolves_phase` frontmatter tag — todos without it must be moved to completed/ manually.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures occurred multiple times requiring the user to restart the desktop app; no programmatic recovery path exists.
gsd commit helper false negatives ('committed: false' when the commit actually landed) forced a git log verification step after every critical commit.
Three session quota interruptions during execution required re-dispatching background agents and cross-checking worktree state before resuming.
cleanup-wave CWD sensitivity caused false base_mismatch failures on the first wave-2 merge attempt; required diagnosing from git branch state before retrying.
cleanup-wave non-idempotency forced writing reduced manifests with only unmerged entries for every retry, adding manual bookkeeping overhead.
42-05 merge left MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed); required manual `git commit --no-edit` followed by worktree remove and branch -D.
Planner agent socket error after writing plans 01-03 required filesystem inspection to confirm partial completeness before spawning a continuation planner.
Prettier was mangling planning documents and VALIDATION.md test command tables on every pre-commit run because no .prettierignore existed.
pnpm + jest testPathPattern forwarding silently broke test filtering; required switching to `pnpm exec jest` invocations throughout.
Assistant answered a direct user question (about unpin exposure surface and CID discoverability) with an AskUserQuestion menu instead of plain prose, requiring an explicit correction from the user.
ROADMAP.md phase-complete annotations were not reflected after `query phase.complete` calls on several attempts, requiring manual verification each time.
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build side-effects had to be manually restored before each wave merge to prevent spurious conflicts.
winfsp cross-compilation is impossible on macOS, making it impossible to fully gate Windows crate changes; cargo check on project crates was used as a partial substitute.
open_items: Phase 44 (IPNS conflict handling): CONTEXT.md and DISCUSSION-LOG.md written and committed on feat/ipns-conflict-handling, but planning and execution have not started.
Phase 43 close-out not fully finalized: the Windows CR-08 alignment fix was committed but re-verification update and phase.complete call were still in progress at transcript end.
SECURITY.md is missing for Phase 42 — the security gate flagged it; /gsd:secure-phase 42 needs to be run.
Pending-uploads UI: surfacing in-progress write queue to users was explicitly deferred as a future improvement during Phase 43 discussion.
BYO provider.unpin client wiring: the SDK's provider.unpin is not yet wired into client-side delete flows (deferred from Phase 42 scope).
Writable-share prunedCids leak: shared-write saves drop prunedCids without calling unpin, leaving stale quota rows — deferred from Phase 42.
Rust FUSE merge parity for Phase 44 IPNS conflict handling: the three-way merge / typed ConflictError approach was scoped to TypeScript callers only; Rust parity explicitly deferred.

Drift reconciliation job: the read-only drift report (detect-only) identifies pins in Kubo not in pinned_cids, but auto-GC was intentionally excluded — a human-reviewed action on drift findings is still needed.
Phase 43 ROADMAP traceability warning surfaced during close-out — noted but not resolved in the transcript.
Phase 43 re-verification of Windows CR-08 alignment: the VERIFICATION.md was not yet updated to reflect the fix before the transcript ended.
